about: Antardasha: the sub-period inside the running mahadasha, and the pair the two lords make. This is the granularity a question about a particular year actually needs - a Saturn mahadasha runs nineteen years and says almost nothing about next March, while the sub-period inside it runs months to about three years. All eighty-one pairs are written, nine sub-lords for each of the nine mahadasha lords, each read out of BPHS and cited by chapter and verse. BPHS devotes one chapter to each lord: Sun 52, Moon 53, Mars 54, Rahu 55, Jupiter 56, Saturn 57, Mercury 58, Ketu 59, Venus 60. The file was once only three of those nine, and the hole was found by a reader looking up a Rahu sub-period and getting nothing back, so a test now names all eighty-one cells rather than counting them. They follow the structure of the text rather than flattening it. BPHS states most sub-period results conditionally on where the sub-period lord sits - in an angle or a trine, exalted or in its own sign, in the eleventh, and so on - so these rules carry that condition and stay silent when it is not met. The adverse verses, covering the badly placed case, are not written, so silence means the favourable condition failed and not that nothing is known. Fifteen pairs carry no placement condition at all, because the verse turns on something the condition language cannot express: association with the lord of the Lagna or of another bhava, a benefic aspect, technical strength, a navamsa position, or the Moon's phase. Those fire for every chart in their sub-period, which is wider than the verse warrants, and their confidence is reduced to say so. Three pairs invert the pattern because the text does: Ketu in Saturn carries no condition since the verse gives its evil result even for a well-placed Ketu, Rahu in Saturn is adverse unless Rahu is well placed, and Saturn in Ketu is adverse on a bad placement rather than good on a fine one. Sun in Venus rests on a verse its own translator calls into question - see its note. At most one pair can be true at a time, so a duplicated pair would be a rule that can never fire and a missing one a sub-period the reading passes over in silence.

rules.name: Saturn in Saturn
rules.says: Position and authority conferred rather than fought for: land, livestock and property added, command over others by a superior's favour, and contentment at home. The one stretch of a Saturn period that pays outright.
rules.note: BPHS gives these results only where Saturn is strong - in its own sign or exaltation, in an angle or a trine, or acting as a yoga-karaka. The yoga-karaka test is not encoded, so the condition here is the dignity and the angle or trine. The adverse verses for a weak Saturn, 4 to 7, are not yet written.

rules.name: Mercury in Saturn
rules.says: Respect from people and a good name, money and comforts coming in, an inclination to religious observance and to travel for it, and health and spirits holding up. The easiest stretch of a Saturn period.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Mercury standing in an angle or a trine. The contrary verses, 12 to 15, which turn on Mercury being in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Lagna or from Saturn, are not yet written.

rules.name: Ketu in Saturn
rules.says: Loss of position, danger, poverty and distress, and journeys away from home.
rules.note: Written without a placement condition on purpose. The verse gives the evil effects even where Ketu is exalted, in its own or a benefic sign, in an angle or a trine, or aspected by benefics - the opposite of how the rest of the chapter reads, and the reason this pair is worth stating at all.

rules.name: Venus in Saturn
rules.says: Marriage, a child, money and sound health, honours and gifts of clothes and ornaments, and well-being through the family. The most favourable sub-period of a Saturn period.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Venus in an angle, a trine or the eleventh, with benefic company or aspect. The benefic-aspect part is not encoded; the angle, trine and eleventh are.

rules.name: Sun in Saturn
rules.says: Good standing with an employer, well-being in the family, happiness from children, and gains of conveyance and livestock.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the Sun exalted or in its own sign, or in an angle or trine with benefic company or aspect, or joined to the ninth lord. The benefic aspect and the ninth-lord association are not encoded.

rules.name: Moon in Saturn
rules.says: Gains of conveyance, clothes and ornaments, fortune improving, care taken of brothers, and happiness on both the mother's and the father's side.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the Moon being full, exalted, in its own sign, in an angle or trine, in the eleventh from Saturn, or aspected by benefics. Fullness and benefic aspect are not encoded; the rest is, including the eleventh from the period lord.

rules.name: Mars in Saturn
rules.says: Enjoyments and gain of wealth, respect from those in authority, conveyances, clothes and ornaments, a command over others, land and livestock increasing, and a new house built.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Mars exalted or in its own sign, or associated with the Lagna lord or with the period lord. Association with Saturn is encoded directly; association with the Lagna lord is not, because the condition language names planets rather than lordships inside a conjunction.

rules.name: Rahu in Saturn
rules.says: Quarrels, mental and physical distress, friction with one's own children, illness, money going out for nothing, discord with close relations, trouble from the government, journeys away from home, and loss of house or land.
rules.note: The condition is inverted, following the verse: the adverse result holds unless Rahu is exalted or otherwise well placed. What counts as otherwise auspicious is left open in the text, so it is read here as exaltation, own sign, or an angle or trine.

rules.name: Jupiter in Saturn
rules.says: Success in most things attempted, well-being in the family, gains of conveyance, ornaments and clothes through a superior's favour, respect, and the company of learned people.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Jupiter in an angle or a trine, in its own sign or exaltation, or associated with the Lagna lord. The Lagna-lord association is not encoded.

rules.name: Venus in Venus
rules.says: Money and livestock coming in through learned or priestly people, celebration over the birth of a son, recognition from those in authority, and a position of standing acquired.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Venus in an angle, a trine or the eleventh, and endowed with strength. Strength in the technical sense is not computed here, so the condition is the placement only.

rules.name: Sun in Venus
rules.says: A stretch of distress, the displeasure of those in authority, and quarrels with co-heirs over shared property.
rules.note: The one adverse pair in the chapter, and the shakiest rule in this file. Santhanam appends a note to this verse saying it does not appear correctly worded, because the Sun does give good results from positions other than exaltation or debilitation, and that the Chowkhamba edition states it correctly. The verse is encoded as it stands, at reduced confidence, with the translator's doubt recorded here rather than silently resolved.

rules.name: Moon in Venus
rules.says: Money, conveyances and clothes through a superior's favour, contentment at home, considerable prosperity, and a turn towards devotion.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the Moon exalted or in her own sign, in an angle, trine or the eleventh, or associated with the ninth or tenth lord or with benefics. The lordship and benefic associations are not encoded.

rules.name: Mars in Venus
rules.says: Position, property, clothes, ornaments and land acquired, and much of what was wanted obtained.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Mars in an angle, trine or the eleventh, or exalted or in one of his own signs, or associated with the lord of the Lagna, the ninth or the tenth. The lordship associations are not encoded.

rules.name: Rahu in Venus
rules.says: Considerable enjoyment, money, friends visiting, journeys that come off, and gains of livestock and land.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Rahu in an angle, trine or the eleventh, exalted or in his own sign, or with benefic company or aspect. The benefic association is not encoded.

rules.name: Jupiter in Venus
rules.says: Something lost recovered, grain, clothes and property obtained, respect from friends and from those in authority, a good name, study of the sacred texts, the birth of a son, and close friends visiting.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Jupiter exalted, in his own sign, or in an angle or trine counted either from the Lagna or from the period lord. Only the Lagna-based angle and trine are encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Venus
rules.says: Considerable enjoyment, friends and kinsmen visiting, recognition from those in authority, the birth of a daughter, pilgrimage, and authority conferred.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Saturn exalted, in his own sign, in an angle or trine, or in his own navamsa. The navamsa test is not encoded, because the app computes no divisional charts.

rules.name: Mercury in Venus
rules.says: Fortune turning, the birth of a son, money gained through a judgement at law, the company of poets and of people worth listening to, and an easy relationship with an employer.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Mercury in an angle, trine or the eleventh - counted from the Lagna or from the period lord - or exalted. Only the Lagna-based count is encoded.

rules.name: Ketu in Venus
rules.says: Unusual gains in the occupation and an increase in livestock, from the very start of the sub-period.
rules.note: The thinnest condition in the chapter. BPHS asks for Ketu exalted or in his own sign, related to a yoga-karaka, or possessed of positional strength - and Santhanam appends that it is not laid down anywhere in which bhava Ketu gets positional strength. Only the dignity is encoded.

rules.name: Mars in Mars
rules.says: Money through a superior's favour, something lost recovered, and the birth of a son.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Mars in an angle, or in the fifth, ninth, eleventh, third or second, or associated with the Lagna lord. The lordship association is not encoded.

rules.name: Rahu in Mars
rules.says: Recognition from government, a house or land gained, happiness from a son, unusual profit in business, pilgrimage and journeys abroad.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Rahu in his moolatrikona or exaltation, in an angle, or in the eleventh, fifth or ninth, and associated with benefics. The benefic association is not encoded.

rules.name: Jupiter in Mars
rules.says: A good name and public honour, wealth and grain increasing, contentment at home, property gained, and happiness from wife and children.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Jupiter in the ninth or fifth, in an angle, the eleventh or the second, or in his exalted or own navamsa. The navamsa test is not encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Mars
rules.says: Recognition from those in authority, a growing reputation, wealth and grain, happiness from children and grandchildren, and livestock increasing.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Saturn in an angle or trine, in his moolatrikona, in his exalted or own navamsa, or associated with the Lagna lord or with benefics. The navamsa and the associations are not encoded.

rules.name: Mercury in Mars
rules.says: The company of devout people, religious observance and charity, a gain in reputation, a turn towards diplomacy, conveyances, clothes and livestock, authority in a superior's service, and success on the land.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Ketu in Mars
rules.says: A superior's favour and money with it, small gains of land early in the sub-period and larger ones later, the birth of a son, authority conferred, and livestock gained.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Ketu in an angle or trine, in the third or the eleventh, or with benefic company or aspect. The benefic association is not encoded.

rules.name: Venus in Mars
rules.says: Position acquired, considerable enjoyment and comfort, and gains of livestock and clothes.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on Venus in an angle from the Lagna, exalted or in her own sign, or ruling the Lagna, the fifth or the ninth. The lordship test is not encoded.

rules.name: Sun in Mars
rules.says: Conveyances and a gain in reputation, the birth of a son, growing wealth, an amicable household, sound health, and unusual profit in business.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the Sun exalted or in his own sign, or in an angle or a trine.

rules.name: Moon in Mars
rules.says: Property gained, perfumes and clothes, wells and shelters built, marriages and other celebrations, happiness from wife and children, and good relations with parents.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the Moon exalted or in her own sign, or in an angle, the ninth, the fourth or the tenth, or in the Lagna with the lords of those bhavas. The verse adds that the results come in full for a waxing Moon and reduced for a waning one, which is not encoded because the app does not compute the phase.

rules.name: Sun in Sun
rules.says: Wealth and grain acquired, and the period's own significations at their strongest.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun exalted, in his own bhava, in the eleventh, or in an angle or trine. BPHS adds that a debilitated or badly placed Sun gives adverse results and other positions middling ones; those branches are not written.

rules.name: Moon in Sun
rules.says: Marriage and similar occasions, money and property, a house, land, livestock and conveyances.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon in an angle or a trine, which is encoded. The verse carries two branches with different results: this one, and a second for the Moon exalted or in her own sign, which gives marriage, children and royal favour instead. Only the first is written, so a chart with an exalted Moon here gets nothing rather than the other reading.

rules.name: Mars in Sun
rules.says: Land acquired, wealth and grain, and a house.
rules.note: Conditional on Mars exalted, in his own sign, or in an angle or trine - all encoded. The verse also allows association with the Lagna lord, which the condition language cannot name.

rules.name: Rahu in Sun
rules.says: Gains through unorthodox means and favour from those in power, where Rahu is well placed.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu in an angle or a trine from the Lagna. The verse adds association with a yoga-karaka, or auspicious placement from the period lord, which are not encoded.

rules.name: Jupiter in Sun
rules.says: Marriage, favour from those in authority, money and grain, the birth of a son, and ambitions met.
rules.note: Conditional on Jupiter in an angle or trine to the Lagna, exalted, in his own sign, or in his own varga. The varga test is not encoded, because the app computes no divisional charts.

rules.name: Saturn in Sun
rules.says: Enemies undone, enjoyment, some gain of grain, and auspicious occasions such as a marriage at home.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Mercury in Sun
rules.says: Position acquired, enthusiasm and liveliness, happiness from wife and children, and a conveyance through a superior's favour.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Ketu in Sun
rules.says: Body pains and mental distress, loss of money, danger from those in authority, and quarrels with kinsmen.
rules.note: No placement condition in the verse, so none here. One of the few sub-periods BPHS states adversely without qualification.

rules.name: Venus in Sun
rules.says: Marriage and contentment with a wife, property gained, travel, meeting learned and powerful people, and position acquired.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus exalted, in her own sign, in her own varga, or in a friendly sign. The varga test is not encoded.

rules.name: Moon in Moon
rules.says: Horses, elephants and clothes, devotion and religious song, position acquired, and considerable happiness, name and fame.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon exalted, in her own sign, in an angle or a trine, or associated with the ninth or tenth lord. The lordship association is not encoded.

rules.name: Mars in Moon
rules.says: Fortune advancing, recognition from government, clothes and ornaments, success in what is attempted, and better yield from the land.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Rahu in Moon
rules.says: A mixed stretch, favourable where Rahu is strongly placed and troublesome where it is not.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu in an angle or a trine. The verse's detail is thin in this translation, so the statement is kept general rather than invented around it.

rules.name: Jupiter in Moon
rules.says: Position acquired, auspicious celebrations at home, clothes and ornaments, and recognition from those in authority.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being exalted, in its own sign or in moolatrikona, or in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Moon
rules.says: The birth of a son, friendship, money and property, profit in business through working people, and better yield from the land.
rules.note: Conditional on Saturn in the eleventh and endowed with strength. Strength in the technical sense is not computed, so the condition is the placement only.

rules.name: Mercury in Moon
rules.says: Money, recognition from those in authority, clothes, and learning through the company of educated people.
rules.note: Conditional on Mercury in his own sign, own navamsa, or exaltation, endowed with strength. The navamsa and strength tests are not encoded.

rules.name: Ketu in Moon
rules.says: Money and enjoyment, happiness from wife and children, and a turn towards religion - though BPHS notes some loss of money at the start of the sub-period.
rules.note: Conditional on Ketu in an angle, a trine or the third, and endowed with strength. Strength is not encoded.

rules.name: Venus in Moon
rules.says: Position acquired, clothes, ornaments, livestock and conveyances, happiness from wife and children, and a new house built.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus in an angle, trine, the eleventh, fourth or ninth, or exalted or in her own sign - all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Sun in Moon
rules.says: Something lost recovered, contentment at home, and villages and land gained with the help of friends and those in authority.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun exalted, in his own sign, in an angle, or in the fifth, ninth, eleventh, second or third - all encoded.

rules.name: Rahu in Rahu
rules.says: Position acquired, enthusiasm, good relations with those in power, happiness from wife and children, and property increasing.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius and in the third, sixth, tenth or eleventh, or joined to a yoga-karaka in exaltation. The sign list and the house list are encoded; the yoga-karaka test is not.

rules.name: Jupiter in Rahu
rules.says: Position gained, patience, enemies undone, enjoyment, good relations with those in power, and wealth and property increasing steadily, as the Moon grows through the bright fortnight.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being exalted, in its own sign or in moolatrikona, or in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded. The verse also offers a navamsa or varga position, which the condition language cannot express.

rules.name: Saturn in Rahu
rules.says: Favour for service rendered, auspicious occasions at home such as a marriage, a garden or reservoir built, and money and livestock from well-to-do people - against which BPHS sets loss of money caused by authority during a journey.
rules.note: Conditional on Saturn in an angle, trine, exaltation, his own sign, his moolatrikona, the third or the eleventh - all encoded.

rules.name: Mercury in Rahu
rules.says: A raja yoga, well-being in the family, profit in business, conveyances, marriage and other auspicious occasions, and livestock increasing.
rules.note: Conditional on Mercury exalted, in an angle, or in the fifth. Encoded. The verse adds that Mercury be endowed with strength, which is not computed.

rules.name: Ketu in Rahu
rules.says: A sub-period BPHS treats guardedly: the two shadow grahas together, with the result turning on whether benefics reach Ketu.
rules.note: BPHS makes this conditional on something the condition language cannot express - Ketu being joined to or aspected by benefics - so the rule carries no placement test and fires for every chart in this sub-period. That is wider than the verse warrants, and the confidence is reduced to say so.

rules.name: Venus in Rahu
rules.says: Money through learned or priestly people, livestock increasing, celebration for the birth of a son, recognition from government, and a high position with considerable comfort.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus with strength in an angle, trine or the eleventh. The placement is encoded; strength is not.

rules.name: Sun in Rahu
rules.says: Good relations with those in authority, wealth and grain increasing, some popularity, and the possibility of heading a local body.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun exalted, in his own sign, in the eleventh, in an angle or a trine, or in his exalted or own navamsa. The navamsa test is not encoded.

rules.name: Moon in Rahu
rules.says: Position acquired, respect from those in authority, money, sound health, garments and ornaments, happiness from children, conveyances, and house and land increasing.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon in a friendly sign and receiving a benefic aspect. The friendly sign is encoded, widened to include her own and exaltation; the benefic aspect is not.

rules.name: Mars in Rahu
rules.says: Something lost recovered - position or money - property at home, better yield from the land, the household deity's blessing, happiness from children, and good food.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being exalted, in its own sign or in moolatrikona, or in an angle, or in the fifth or ninth or eleventh, all of which is encoded. The verse also offers a benefic aspect or association, which the condition language cannot express.

rules.name: Jupiter in Jupiter
rules.says: Authority over others, considerable wealth, reverence from those in power, and gains of livestock, clothes, ornaments and conveyances.
rules.note: Conditional on Jupiter exalted, in his own sign, or in an angle or trine - all encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Jupiter
rules.says: Position acquired, clothes, ornaments, wealth, grain, conveyances and livestock, and happiness from a son.
rules.note: Conditional on Saturn exalted, in his own sign, or in an angle or trine, endowed with strength. Strength is not encoded.

rules.name: Mercury in Jupiter
rules.says: Money, physical well-being, position acquired, and gains of conveyances, clothes and livestock.
rules.note: Conditional on Mercury being associated with the period lord, which the condition language can express directly - so this one is encoded exactly as the verse states it.

rules.name: Ketu in Jupiter
rules.says: Moderate enjoyment and moderate gain, coarse food or food given by others, and food served at funeral rites.
rules.note: BPHS makes this conditional on something the condition language cannot express - Ketu being joined to or aspected by a benefic - so the rule carries no placement test and fires for every chart in this sub-period. That is wider than the verse warrants, and the confidence is reduced to say so.

rules.name: Venus in Jupiter
rules.says: Conveyances of the grander sort, money through a superior's favour, enjoyment, unusual income from travel eastward, well-being in the family, and happiness from parents.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus in an angle, trine or the eleventh, or in her own sign with a benefic aspect. The benefic aspect is not encoded.

rules.name: Sun in Jupiter
rules.says: Money, reverence, happiness, conveyances, clothes and ornaments, the birth of children, and cordial relations with those in power.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun exalted, in his own sign, in an angle or trine, or in the third, eleventh or second, endowed with strength. Strength is not encoded.

rules.name: Moon in Jupiter
rules.says: Reverence from those in authority, opulence, happiness from wife and children, good food, and a gain in reputation.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon in an angle, trine or the eleventh, or exalted or in her own sign - all encoded. The verse further asks that she be full and strong and well placed from the period lord, none of which is computed.

rules.name: Mars in Jupiter
rules.says: Occasions such as a marriage, land or villages gained, strength and valour growing, and success in what is undertaken.
rules.note: Conditional on Mars exalted, in his own sign, or in his exalted or own navamsa. The navamsa test is not encoded.

rules.name: Rahu in Jupiter
rules.says: An attachment to practice and discipline, money and grain in the first five months, authority over a place, and meetings with powerful people.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu exalted, in his own sign or moolatrikona, or in an angle or trine - all encoded. A benefic aspect is offered as an alternative and is not.

rules.name: Mercury in Mercury
rules.says: Jewels and pearls, learning, happiness and pious acts, success in study, a name made, and happiness from wife, children and parents.
rules.note: Conditional on Mercury in his exaltation sign or otherwise well placed, which the verse leaves loose; it is read here as exaltation, own sign, moolatrikona, or an angle or trine.

rules.name: Ketu in Mercury
rules.says: Physical fitness, a little money, affectionate relations with kinsmen, livestock increasing, income from industry, success in study, and honours.
rules.note: Conditional on Ketu with benefics in an angle or trine, joined to the Lagna lord or a yoga-karaka, or in an angle or the eleventh from the period lord. The placements are encoded, including the count from the period lord; the associations are not.

rules.name: Venus in Mercury
rules.says: A turn to religious observance, ambitions met through the help of friends and those in authority, and ornaments gained.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus in an angle, or in the fifth, ninth or eleventh from the period lord - encoded exactly, counted from Mercury rather than from the Lagna.

rules.name: Sun in Mercury
rules.says: Fortune turning through a superior's favour, and happiness from friends.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun in his own or exaltation sign, in an angle or trine, or in the second or eleventh - all encoded. The navamsa alternative is not.

rules.name: Moon in Mercury
rules.says: Marriage, the birth of a son, and gains of clothes and ornaments.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon in an angle or trine, the verse adding that the yoga is very strong where she is herself a yoga-karaka. The yoga-karaka test is not encoded.

rules.name: Mars in Mercury
rules.says: Well-being and enjoyment in the family through a superior's favour, property increasing, and something lost recovered.
rules.note: Conditional on Mars exalted, in his own sign, or in an angle or trine - all encoded. Association with the Lagna lord is offered as an alternative and cannot be named.

rules.name: Rahu in Mercury
rules.says: Reverence from those in authority, a good name, money, visits to sacred places and the performance of rites - with some trouble at the very start of the sub-period.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu in Aries, Aquarius, Virgo or Taurus, which is encoded as a sign list.

rules.name: Jupiter in Mercury
rules.says: Physical well-being, money, a superior's favour, and auspicious occasions such as a marriage at home.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being exalted, in its own sign or in moolatrikona, or in an angle, or in a trine, or in the eleventh, all of which is encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Mercury
rules.says: Well-being in the family, position acquired, enthusiasm, livestock increasing, and a post gained.
rules.note: Conditional on Saturn exalted, in his own sign, in an angle or trine, or in the eleventh - all encoded.

rules.name: Ketu in Ketu
rules.says: Happiness from wife and children and recognition from those in authority, and mental distress alongside it; land or a village gained.
rules.note: Conditional on Ketu in an angle or a trine, which is encoded. The verse offers relation to the lord of the ninth, tenth or fourth as an alternative; those are lordships, not placements, and cannot be expressed.

rules.name: Venus in Ketu
rules.says: A superior's favour, good fortune, clothes, something lost recovered, and conveyances.
rules.note: Conditional on Venus exalted or in her own sign, or placed in an angle or trine - encoded. The verse ties the angle to association with the tenth lord, which is not expressible, so this is read as the placement alone.

rules.name: Sun in Ketu
rules.says: Money, a superior's favour, pious acts, and ambitions met.
rules.note: Conditional on the Sun exalted or in his own sign, or joined to or aspected by a benefic in an angle, trine or the eleventh. The placements are encoded; the benefic association is not.

rules.name: Moon in Ketu
rules.says: Recognition from those in authority, enthusiasm, well-being and enjoyment, a house and land, and unusual gains of food and grain.
rules.note: Conditional on the Moon exalted, in her own sign, in an angle or trine, or in the eleventh or second - all encoded. The verse elsewhere prefers a waxing Moon, a phase the app does not compute.

rules.name: Mars in Ketu
rules.says: Land or a village acquired, wealth and livestock increasing, a garden laid out, and money through a superior's favour.
rules.note: Conditional on Mars exalted or in his own sign, which is encoded. A benefic association or aspect is offered as an alternative and is not.

rules.name: Rahu in Ketu
rules.says: Wealth increasing, and grain, livestock, land and a village gained from a foreign ruler.
rules.note: Conditional on Rahu exalted, in his own or a friendly sign, in an angle or trine, or in the eleventh, third or second - all encoded.

rules.name: Jupiter in Ketu
rules.says: Wealth and grain increasing, a superior's favour, enthusiasm, conveyances, and a celebration such as a birth.
rules.note: Conditional on Jupiter exalted or in his own sign, or associated with the lord of the Lagna, ninth or tenth in an angle or trine. The lordship associations are not encoded.

rules.name: Saturn in Ketu
rules.says: Distress to oneself and one's kinsmen, and loss of money through fines or levies - set against an increase in livestock.
rules.note: The condition is a bad placement rather than a good one, following the verse: Saturn in the eighth or the twelfth. One of the few adverse sub-periods BPHS states with a placement test.

rules.name: Mercury in Ketu
rules.says: Position acquired, enjoyment, charity, money and land, the birth of a son, and religious celebrations.
rules.note: Conditional in BPHS on the sub-period lord being exalted, in its own sign or in moolatrikona, or in an angle, or in a trine, all of which is encoded.
